package main

// Fixture generator for K3, built against 6172744's own package. It writes 0.1.0
// data directories with record() and saveInputsLocked(), then opens a copy of each
// with newApp() and records whether 0.1.0 starts on it and what it restores.
// Synthetic content only. Run: FIXTURE_OUT=<dir> go test -run TestGenerateFixtures

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func fixtureApp(t *testing.T, dir string) *app {
	t.Helper()
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(dir, "sessions.jsonl"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { f.Close() })
	return &app{dataDir: dir, journal: f}
}

func fsession(id, provider string) *session {
	s := emptySession(provider, "/work/"+id, "")
	s.ID, s.ProviderID = id, "prov-"+id
	return s
}

func must(t *testing.T, err error) {
	t.Helper()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func receipts(t *testing.T, a *app) {
	for _, flow := range []struct {
		id, provider string
		states       []string
	}{
		{"created", "claude", []string{"created"}},
		{"intent", "codex", []string{"created", "intent"}},
		{"accepted", "codex", []string{"created", "intent", "accepted"}},
		{"final", "claude", []string{"created", "intent", "accepted", "final"}},
		{"rejected", "codex", []string{"created", "intent", "rejected"}},
		{"unknown", "codex", []string{"created", "intent", "unknown"}},
		{"paused", "codex", []string{"created", "intent", "accepted", "paused"}},
		{"cwdafter", "claude", []string{"created", "intent", "final", "cwd"}},
		{"closed", "codex", []string{"created", "intent", "final", "closed"}},
	} {
		s := fsession(flow.id, flow.provider)
		for _, state := range flow.states {
			request := ""
			switch state {
			case "intent", "accepted", "final", "rejected", "unknown", "paused":
				request = "req-" + flow.id
			}
			if state == "cwd" {
				s.CWD = "/work/moved"
			}
			must(t, a.record(s, request, state))
		}
	}
	// admission_failed is written with an empty provider ID.
	s := emptySession("codex", "/work/af", "")
	s.ID = "admission"
	must(t, a.record(s, "", "admission_failed"))
}

func checkpointAndReview(t *testing.T, a *app) {
	s := fsession("task", "codex")
	s.task = &trackedTask{ID: "task-1", Generation: 2, InputRevision: 3, ObjectiveHash: objectiveHash("objective"), State: "running", Stage: "plan", passes: map[string]string{"plan": "d1"}, attempts: map[string]int{}}
	s.task.objective = "objective"
	must(t, a.record(s, "", "created"))
	must(t, a.record(s, "", "checkpoint:running:plan:task-1:2"))
	must(t, a.record(s, "req-task", "intent"))
	must(t, a.record(s, "req-task", "final"))
	r := fsession("review", "codex")
	r.reviewParent, r.reviewTaskID, r.reviewGeneration, r.reviewStage = "task", "task-1", 2, "plan"
	must(t, a.record(r, "req-review", "review_unknown"))
}

func many(t *testing.T, a *app) {
	for i := 0; i < 30; i++ {
		s := fsession(fmt.Sprintf("m%02d", i), "codex")
		must(t, a.record(s, "", "created"))
		if i%7 == 0 {
			must(t, a.record(s, "req-m", "intent"))
		}
	}
}

func queue(t *testing.T, a *app, id string, identity string) {
	s := fsession(id, "codex")
	must(t, a.record(s, "", "created"))
	attachments := filepath.Join(a.dataDir, "attachments")
	must(t, os.MkdirAll(attachments, 0o700))
	body := []byte("synthetic attachment " + id)
	path := filepath.Join(attachments, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef-note.txt")
	must(t, os.WriteFile(path, body, 0o600))
	sum := sha256.Sum256(body)
	text := "synthetic queued text " + id
	s.inputs = []*queuedInput{{RequestID: "q-" + id, RequestHash: objectiveHash("rh-" + id), Status: "queued", CreatedAt: "2026-11-03T10:00:00Z", Text: text, PayloadHash: objectiveHash(text), Snapshots: map[string]attachmentSnapshot{"/user/note.txt": {Path: path, Hash: hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), Size: int64(len(body)), DirectoryIdentity: identity}}}}
	must(t, a.saveInputsLocked(s))
}

// observe opens a copy of dir with the real 0.1.0 startup and records the outcome.
func observe(t *testing.T, dir string) string {
	copyDir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "data")
	must(t, copyTree(dir, copyDir))
	a, err := newApp(copyDir, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return "refuses: " + err.Error() + "\n"
	}
	defer a.close()
	lines := []string{"starts"}
	for _, s := range a.sessions {
		lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("session %s status=%s inputs=%d", s.ID, s.Status, len(s.inputs)))
	}
	for _, r := range a.reviews {
		lines = append(lines, "review "+r.ID+" parent="+r.reviewParent)
	}
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n"
}

func copyTree(from, to string) error {
	return filepath.Walk(from, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(from, path)
		target := filepath.Join(to, rel)
		if info.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0o700)
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// Snapshot paths are absolute, so the copy points them at itself, as a test
		// harness installing a fixture does.
		data = []byte(strings.ReplaceAll(string(data), from, to))
		return os.WriteFile(target, data, 0o600)
	})
}

// finish replaces the generation directory path with a placeholder, so tests can
// install a fixture anywhere, and writes the 0.1.0 observation beside it.
func finish(t *testing.T, out, name, dir string) {
	target := filepath.Join(out, name)
	must(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(target, "data"), 0o755))
	var names []string
	must(t, filepath.Walk(dir, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
		if err != nil || info.IsDir() || info.Name() == "console.lock" {
			return err
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(dir, path)
		names = append(names, rel)
		return nil
	}))
	sort.Strings(names)
	for _, rel := range names {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, rel))
		must(t, err)
		data = []byte(strings.ReplaceAll(string(data), dir, "@DATADIR@"))
		dest := filepath.Join(target, "data", rel)
		must(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dest), 0o755))
		must(t, os.WriteFile(dest, data, 0o644))
	}
	must(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(target, "observed-0.1.txt"), []byte(observe(t, dir)), 0o644))
}

func TestGenerateFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("FIXTURE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("FIXTURE_OUT not set")
	}
	build := func(name string, fill func(*app)) string {
		dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "data")
		a := fixtureApp(t, dir)
		fill(a)
		return dir
	}
	all := build("receipts", func(a *app) { receipts(t, a); checkpointAndReview(t, a) })
	finish(t, out, "receipts", all)
	finish(t, out, "many", build("many", func(a *app) { many(t, a) }))
	finish(t, out, "queue", build("queue", func(a *app) { queue(t, a, "qs", "1:2") }))
	finish(t, out, "queue-no-identity", build("queue-no-identity", func(a *app) { queue(t, a, "qn", "") }))
	orphan := build("orphan", func(a *app) {
		queue(t, a, "orph", "1:2")
		s := fsession("orph", "codex")
		must(t, a.record(s, "", "closed"))
	})
	finish(t, out, "orphan-queue", orphan)
	corrupt := build("corrupt-queue", func(a *app) { queue(t, a, "cq", "1:2") })
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte("cq"))
	must(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(corrupt, "queued-inputs", hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])+".json"), []byte("{not json"), 0o600))
	finish(t, out, "corrupt-queue", corrupt)
	torn := build("torn", func(a *app) { receipts(t, a) })
	f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(torn, "sessions.jsonl"), os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
	must(t, err)
	_, err = f.WriteString(`{"at":"2026-11-03T10:00:00Z","sessionId":"torn","prov`)
	must(t, err)
	f.Close()
	finish(t, out, "torn-tail", torn)
	bad := build("corrupt-line", func(a *app) { receipts(t, a) })
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(bad, "sessions.jsonl"))
	must(t, err)
	lines := strings.SplitAfter(string(data), "\n")
	lines = append(lines[:3], append([]string{"not json at all\n"}, lines[3:]...)...)
	must(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(bad, "sessions.jsonl"), []byte(strings.Join(lines, "")), 0o600))
	finish(t, out, "corrupt-line", bad)
	empty := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "data")
	must(t, os.MkdirAll(empty, 0o700))
	finish(t, out, "missing-journal", empty)
}
